caption: The drawing depicts a single black metal stove with a slightly trapezoidal body standing on three legs, each of which is thin and angled outward. The stove has a front door with a small latch and a few visible hinges, as well as a small, round handle. The top of the stove has a small, rectangular section supporting a slim vertical chimney pipe that extends upward. A curved, oval-shaped black surface projects from the bottom front of the stove, possibly representing a hearth or base plate. The stove sits on a flat surface, with a large, irregularly shaped red mat or shadow underneath it that extends outward and has both straight and curved edges. The background is plain and off-white. The colors used are predominantly black, gray, and red. The name "Geo. V. Vesiles" is written in small print at the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Stove
